title: region-bound-service-account-attestations-and-audit-hash-bridge
author: Aisha Patel
description: Motivation: customers operating across regulated geographies require enforced region pinning for KMS usage and stronger tamper-evidence on audit logs while keeping RBAC v2 decision flow simple for platform teams. This PR implements a region-bound service-account attestation hook and an audit-hash-bridge that generates compact, verifiable audit digests and forwards them into the existing audit pipeline. The attestor enforces that service-account tokens contain an immutable region claim (region_hint) or are mapped via a tenant_region binding; when a mismatch is detected the attestor returns a DENY decision upstream in the RBAC v2 pipeline. The audit-hash-bridge computes incremental HMACs over serialized audit events using tenant-scoped keys; the bridge signs events and emits both the original event and a small audit-proof record to the centralized audit topic. KMS affinity enforcer: a small policy shim chooses the tenant CMK by region tag and rejects cross-region CMK selection when the tenant policy forbids it. Migration and rollout: feature-gated (security.region_attestor + audit.hash_bridge) and rollout plan includes canary in us-east-1 and eu-west-1 with traffic split and automatic fallback to preexisting behavior. Backwards compatibility: attestor is optional; when disabled it is a no-op shim. Testing: unit tests for attestor logic, integration tests that run full RBAC v2 decision flow, e2e test that validates audit-proof roundtrip and reconcile with the audit-consumer. Performance: local benchmark shows median decision latency +1.8% at 95th percentile under synthetic token workloads; bridge throughput 6k events/s per instance. Checklist: [x] spec and design doc added; [x] unit and integration tests; [x] security review requested; [x] helm chart changes for private installer; [x] migration runbook. Related work: ENG-4582, ENG-4699 (policy-mapper), PM-88. This PR touches runtime policy path, audit forwarding, and the helm values used by private deploys; please validate the rollout plan with SRE before merging.
